mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_account ( user_id, student_number, password_hash, status, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{studentNumber}, #{passwordHash}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
INSERT INTO iam_account_role ( account_id, role_code, created_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{roleCode}, #{createdAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_id = VALUES(account_id)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, student_number, password_hash, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM iam_account WHERE student_number = #{studentNumber} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, student_number, password_hash, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM iam_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT role_code FROM iam_account_role WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY role_code
